name: Richards Manufacturing
old_description: Richards has proudly served the energy distribution industry since 1945, earning the respect of customers and competitors alike. To have remained successful after all these years, in a demanding and competitive industry, is no simple task. It takes a lot of hard work, starting with our CEO, who oversees operations everyday…and finishing with the individuals on the production lines, who carefully craft every Richards product. They all share one common focus: satisfying the needs of you, our customer. You want reliability — we manufacture top-quality products that exceed your expectations. You want flexibility — Richards designs, manufactures, and tests many non-standard and specialty products to meet our customers’ requirements. Most of all, you want a trusted partner and you can always rely on Richards to assist you with any problem or emergency in the field.
about:
Richards Manufacturing has operated from Irvington, New Jersey, since its founding in 1945. The company began as a family‑owned business producing a single style of underground connector and has remained under family ownership through its evolution into a multi‑line supplier.

Today the firm designs, manufactures, and tests a broad range of electrical and gas distribution equipment. Its product lines include compression lugs and splices, split‑tinned connectors, medium‑voltage loadbreak and deadbreak elbows (5–35 kV), cold‑shrink terminations, network protectors (800–5,100 A), and natural‑gas meter connections, manifold assemblies, and prefabricated meter installations. Production relies on advanced injection‑molding processes and a high‑voltage test laboratory at the Irvington facility. The company also reconditions utility‑owned network protectors and supplies replacement components. Through its ETI division, Richards provides microprocessor‑based network protector relays (MNPR®), monitoring sensors, and SCADA communications enclosures, with more than 20 major utilities worldwide using the MNPR® system.

Richards serves electric and gas utilities, commercial and industrial customers, and natural‑gas distribution companies. Its network protectors and monitoring systems are deployed by major utilities across the globe, while its connector and medium‑voltage products are specified for underground and overhead distribution networks.

The company emphasizes flexibility in meeting non‑standard and specialty requirements, positioning itself as a partner for field emergencies and custom solutions. Its claim as the largest producer of network protectors and accessories underscores its scale in that niche.
